name: Question
about: Ask a question about moldordie.
labels: question
---

First, make sure to examine the docs in [`docs/`](https://github.com/matsakelarsson/moldordie/tree/main/docs). If that doesn't help, open the question here and we will take a look.

If your question is about behaviour inherited from [cookiecutter-django](https://github.com/cookiecutter/cookiecutter-django) rather than anything specific to this fork, their [discussions](https://github.com/cookiecutter/cookiecutter-django/discussions) and the [`cookiecutter-django` tag on StackOverflow](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/tagged/cookiecutter-django) reach a much larger audience.
